title: An approved X Delivery is sent only when some announce run happens
description: send_due runs only at the end of an announce agent run, and DeliveryTimers is never constructed, so no timer wakes a Delivery whose release time came or that a person approved. An approved post waits for an unrelated rating or publish event. Wire the delivery timers (or a send step on approval).

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Fixed without building a separate deliver agent: the Delivery change feed now emits 'approved' when approvedVersion is set or changes, the announce agent listens for it, and that wake runs only the send step (send_due for X and email). An approval made by the agent itself is its own change and wakes nothing; that run sends at its end as before.
